issues.description: Method parameter name mismatch for GroverLightsOutPuzzle.state_preparation: the template implementation (template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) declares the parameter as 'switch_register' in the method signature, while the problem statement and the solution implementation (solution_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) consistently refer to the same conceptual register as 'flip_register'. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (the register of flips/switches) appears in the method signature and docstring and can confuse students when calling or implementing the method (e.g., grover_circuit, oracle, and other methods use 'flip_register'), leading to naming mismatches or unclear code examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter 'switch_register' to 'flip_register' in the template method signature and any internal references and update the docstring so the template API matches the problem statement and the solution. Ensure all occurrences (method signature, parameter usages, and docstrings) in template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py use 'flip_register' so students have a consistent identifier across problem description, template, and reference solution.
